nodes.name: Sklearn Ensemble Bagging Fit-Scheduling Atoms
nodes.description: Deterministic bagging fit helpers for parallel job partitioning and per-estimator seed generation before the deferred worker builds.

nodes.name: bagging_partition_estimators
nodes.description: Partition a positive bagging estimator count across the effective parallel jobs using sklearn's balanced scheduling rule.
nodes.type_signature: (n_estimators: int, n_jobs: int | None) -> tuple[int, NDArray[np.int64], NDArray[np.int64]]

nodes.name: bagging_fit_seeds
nodes.description: Advance sklearn bagging's warm-start random state by the existing estimator count and return one integer seed per newly requested estimator.
nodes.type_signature: (n_more_estimators: int, previous_estimators: int, random_state: int | np.random.RandomState | None = None) -> NDArray[np.int64]
